proves.claim: A live gate job for a claimed item at its owner, commit and frozen digest reads served, and unserved naming claimed once the item is withdrawn.

moves.backbone-records.a-gate-job-for-a-.why: The backbone's serves facts are U152 derived facts; this is the first code that reads them over the board's own job and item rows.

proves.claim: A job of an unlisted kind, or one whose request lacks a field its serves rule reads, reads unreadable with the kind or field named, and nothing throws.

moves.backbone-records.a-missing-input-o.why: A missing input is unknown, not false, so the trial never counts a board gap as a disagreement.

proves.claim: backboneSummary counts compared, served, unserved and unreadable per kind, and reading a board file leaves it byte-identical.

moves.backbone-records.the-summary-count.why: pullboard moves fills the backbone row from these counts, and the reader must stay read-only.
